About Maliks

Built on experience. Moving forward with you.

We started our journey in 2012. Looking back, it has been an awesome ride with plenty of ups and downs. Whatever the situation, we have always kept moving forward.

Today, Maliks Paint and Hardware supports builders, contractors and homeowners with dependable products, practical advice and service that keeps projects moving from foundation to finish.

2012 Our journey began

One team, one building partner and a complete range for the work ahead.

The Maliks difference

One-stop building support

Everything you need for the building journey, with the product range, practical advice and service to keep your project moving.

One-Stop Building Hub

Find bricks, cement, tiles, sanware, roofing and more under one roof, making your project simpler and less stressful.

Quality You Can Rely On

Trusted, durable products for strong foundations, stylish finishes and lasting value.

Affordable Pricing

Competitive everyday pricing across the range helps your money stretch further without compromising quality.

Expert Service & Advice

Our friendly, knowledgeable team helps you choose the right materials for the job.

Reliable Delivery

Keep your project moving with building materials delivered directly to site, fast and hassle-free.

Community Commitment

Proudly serving Gauteng and beyond, supporting local builders, contractors and homeowners.
